$comment: Single source of the Content-Security-Policy (P1.5). `npm run gen:csp` writes it into public/_headers (HTTP header, applied by Cloudflare) and src/index.html (<meta>, minus the directives a meta policy ignores). `npm run check:csp` fails CI when either file drifts.
script-src never gets 'unsafe-eval' or 'unsafe-inline' (plan section 2, Constraints).
connect-src is open because sending requests to arbitrary user-specified hosts is the app's core feature.
worker-src covers Monaco's workers and the script sandbox worker, both same-origin bundles.
style-src allows 'unsafe-inline' for PrimeNG's inline positioning styles (overlays, dialogs).
Fonts are self-hosted and icons are inline SVG, so no third-party origin appears here.
